name: @bhavya/dependency-rules
description: Dependency enforcement rules for Bhavya OS consolidation

forbidden.reason: Types come from @bhavya/shared. @bhavya/types re-exports from shared.

required.rule: All domain types (Workflow, Event, Memory, Goal, Task, Agent, etc.) must import from @bhavya/shared
required.check: grep -r 'interface Workflow' packages/*/src/ | grep -v shared | grep -v node_modules

required.rule: No package may define its own KnowledgePackage type
required.check: grep -r 'interface KnowledgePackage' packages/*/src/ | grep -v shared | grep -v node_modules
